Ava (CSM): Heads-up: OrionHealth usage dropped ~62% overnight after their ML lead left. Procurement asked for a vendor cost/ops snapshot. Renewal in ~4w. Can we triage fast? :eyes:
Liam (CS Ops): On it. Any signs of key rotation or edge errors?
Ava (CSM): Tenant shows last activity ~48h ago. No console config changes logged. New PM hasn't replied to our invites.
Noor (Solutions Eng): Quick triage checklist to run from their infra: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORION_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health``` 401/403 = token; 429 = throttling; 5xx = edge.
incident-bot: [auto] 2025-05-02T02:11:00Z - edge spike (us-east-2) 02:09-02:16 UTC - ~1.05k requests affected.
Liam (CS Ops): Pulled tenant logs: cluster of 403s at 02:08 UTC then retries hitting transient 503s. Looks like token rejected then edge blip.
Ben (AE): Procurement already demoing CompetitorQ next week, calling out "managed connector" and lower list price. If it's a config issue we can fix quickly. Propose: 1) 7-day Dedicated extension 2) 30m triage with SE 3) benchmark note (p50/p95, token cost, ops delta).
Noor (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a one-pager + tiny benchmark script they can run (ETA today EOD). Example python snippet: ```python
import requests; print(requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer $ORION_TOKEN'}).status_code)
```
Liam (CS Ops): I'll issue a short-lived support token, check tenant throttles, and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if we extend.
Ava (CSM): Action items: @Noor one-pager + script; @Liam support token + billing hold; @Ben outreach to procurement with invite. I'll escalate to exec sponsor if no reply by EOD tomorrow.
Ben (AE): I'll include finance contact and avoid pricing promises.
Noor (Solutions Eng): Draft checklist posted: 1) Validate token 2) Check IP allowlist/firewall 3) Run health & usage checks 4) If 429 -> check quota & request transient bump 5) Enable KV cache & batching on trial 6) Collect request IDs & logs for support
Liam (CS Ops): Noted. Goal: triage within 48h and benchmark within 72h.
Ava (CSM): Thanks team. Will update after procurement reply. :white_check_mark:
